entropy.text: The world is holding together, mostly.

final_cut.story:
Beat 1: Moth casts earthquake on Southern Asia, and 8 more things went sideways.
Beat 2: Time bends the seconds around Juniper, and 3 more things went sideways.
Beat 3: Time's clock catches Rook outside the arena, and 2 more things went sideways.
Beat 4: Time's clock catches Rook outside the arena, and 3 more things went sideways.
Beat 5: Time's clock catches Juniper outside the arena, and 11 more things went sideways.
Beat 6: Time's clock catches Juniper outside the arena, and 11 more things went sideways.
final_cut.title: Final Night 7

piles.name: Rook
piles.statue_prompt: An amiibo-style collectible figure of the demigod Rook, frozen mid-fall (caught outside the arena by Time's clock), on a round base shaped like Madrid, atop a ridiculous towering pile of everything they held and summoned: nothing but debts. Tiny figures of the people they touched cling to the pile: nobody. Two glowing hands hover at their sides.
